title: sqlite SAVEPOINT：实现 NESTED 保存点语义
expected_output:
inside savepoint rows = [1, 2]
after rollback to savepoint rows = [1]
after commit rows = [1, 3]
nested rollback kept outer row 1: True
code:
import sqlite3

con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.execute("CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT)")


def rows():
    return [r[0] for r in cur.execute("SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id")]


cur.execute("INSERT INTO t(id,v) VALUES(1,'A')")
cur.execute("SAVEPOINT sp1")
cur.execute("INSERT INTO t(id,v) VALUES(2,'B')")
print("inside savepoint rows =", rows())
cur.execute("ROLLBACK TO sp1")
cur.execute("RELEASE sp1")
print("after rollback to savepoint rows =", rows())
cur.execute("INSERT INTO t(id,v) VALUES(3,'C')")
con.commit()
print("after commit rows =", rows())
print("nested rollback kept outer row 1:", rows() == [1, 3])
con.close()
